pattern.description: Screen recording: the left navigation sidebar scrolls up by roughly one row inside its fixed panel, revealing Give feedback / Project settings at the bottom while the main table stays still.
pattern.why_premium: Short, smooth wheel scroll confined to the sidebar mask keeps the main view stable, so attention moves to the settings entry without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.sidebar-list', {y: -25, duration: 0.23, ease: 'power2.out'}) inside a container with overflow: hidden
build_hint.remotion: y = interpolate(frame, [0, 7], [0, -25], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the list inside an overflow-hidden sidebar; spring({damping: 30, stiffness: 200}) also fits (no overshoot).

notes: Camera move is none; the small pan_y/scale describe the sidebar scroll only. Many per-item OCR boxes (b04-b20) are the same scroll; listed once via the union box. The Project settings hover highlight may change near the end but is not distinguishable in the filmstrip crop.
